title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode4 The Secret Plan

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then, and then, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki...
I get you're happy about it, but you've already told this story like ten times.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Have I been talking about it that much?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That goes to show how wonderful a memory it is for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! I'm pretty sure I haven't shown you this yet, though!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You see... I got a picture of me and Airi!
Look, look!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow... That's amazing!
I'm so glad for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're looking a little bashful here, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-I mean...!
Airi was so dazzling when she was in idol mode...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My heart really got racing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure it would for me too if I got to take a picture like this with somebody I always dreamed of meeting!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm glad you got a precious photo to put in your album.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what other kinds of pictures have you gotten? You've been doing a bunch of the things on your list, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well... I made a domino chain with Tsukasa... And I studied with my classmates at a diner too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here, these are the pictures!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow... There are dominoes lined up all over the room. Tsukasa looks really serious too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your study session also looks like fun.
Though, I see you all ordered parfaits, pancakes and other treats.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Way too many...
Were you even able to open up your notebooks on that table?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's fine, it's fine!
Time spent snacking and chatting with friends is all part of the study session experience!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Huh? This picture...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, and! This picture is from when me, Ichi and Haruka recorded a challenge video!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A challenge video?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's when people record themselves trying to do something difficult. Like...knocking over a pencil by throwing an eraser from far away.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We set out to roll six dice and have them all land on the same number, and it really was an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! They totally refused to match up, so we rolled like two hundred times!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's the same for this picture...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's in the photo with Momoi, but most of the other pictures are of other people.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And even for the ones she is in, she's not fully in frame since she's holding the camera...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? I got a message from Mom...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ack! I was supposed to pick up the ingredients for dinner today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone!
Mom won't be able to make our ginger fried pork if I don't hurry, so I'll head back now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, be careful not to trip and fall over!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Will do!
See you all tomorrow! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I guess we should start getting ready to head home as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... Hold on a second.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's something I want to talk to you guys about...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So there aren't many decent pictures of Saki, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was kind of thinking that as well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If she's making a photo album, I'm sure it'd be better to have lots of pictures that clearly show her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That should make it easier to remember how much fun she had with everyone whenever she looks at it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, why don't we take pictures of Saki whenever we do the stuff on her list with her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...! That way, we can get good pictures of her!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I think she'll like that...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... I've got an idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you're gonna give her pictures, you should make it a surprise! Don't you think that would make her even happier?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Saki tends to enjoy that sort of thing, so that might be good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then we'll have to be as sneaky as possible with our photography.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Let's do our best to make sure she loves the surprise!
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for coming, everybody!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wanted to play with everyone too, so it's my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's been a while since I've played, so I'm not sure I'll do well... But I'll try my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys! Wh-Wh-Wh-What are we gonna do?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What's wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I went to the gym since I wanted to do some warmup exercises, but there were already some girls there using it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, for real?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm sorry! If I'd just run ahead to secure our spot...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Don't blame yourself.
I hadn't thought about securing a spot either... It's just some bad timing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we go to the schoolyard?
If we draw lines in the dirt with our shoes, we can make a court ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... But I heard the softball team is using the schoolyard. They apparently have a practice match coming up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huuuh? What do we do?!
And after you all came to join me for this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Isn't there any other place that might work...?

Hm?
What are you all doing gathered around here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... Actually, we're looking for somewhere we can play dodgeball. The gym and the schoolyard are both taken.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you know any good spots, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Dodgeball...?
In that case, you'll be able to play as long as there's room to draw up a court, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It might be a bit small, but there's a spot on the way over to the archery range that might work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yeah. It's in an area behind the school that people don't go to that often, so I don't think anyone will be using it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, thanks so much, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Isn't this great, Saki?☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Well, I'll be off.
Have fun, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wait just a moment, please!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Would you like to play dodgeball too, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... I figure you might be busy with studying and stuff, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just know this is gonna be suuuper fun!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, even just for five minutes...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Since you insist, maybe I'll take you up on your offer for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wha—
R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure... I was just thinking that I want to take a breather.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting me along, Otori.
Is that alright with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Of course!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then, I'll go get ready.
